metadata.question: In areas across the northeastern Pacific Ocean, were sea surface temperatures cooler in August 2019 than the average for the same month from 1985-2012?

data.raw_code: 1. Search Strategy: - Collection: NOAA Optimum Interpolation Sea Surface Temperature (OI SST v2 or similar) - Date 1: August 2019 (2019-08-01 to 2019-08-31) - Date 2: August average for 1985-2012 (climatology) - Location: Northeastern Pacific Ocean (approximate bounds: -130°W to -110°W, 30°N to 50°N) - The question asks: Is 2019 August SST < Average(1985-2012) August SST? 2. Masking Strategy: - SST data is already gridded/interpolated, so no cloud masking needed - Check for valid pixels and data availability 3. Logic to Distinguish Valid Answer from Error: - C1: If no data available for either period - C2: If valid pixel count is 0 (unlikely for SST gridded data, but check) - C3: If temperature values are out of realistic range (e.g., <-5°C or >35°C for this region) - A: If mean(2019) < mean(1985-2012) - B: If mean(2019) >= mean(1985-2012) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define northeastern Pacific Ocean region const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-130, 30, -110, 50]); // Load OI SST v2 dataset const sstCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/OI_SST_V2'); // August 2019 data const aug2019 = sstCollection .filterDate('2019-08-01', '2019-08-31') .filterBounds(region); const size2019 = aug2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`August 2019 Images: ${size2019}`); if (size2019 === 0) { console.log('No data for August 2019.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // August 1985-2012 climatology const aug1985to2012 = sstCollection .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1985, 2012, 'year')) .filterBounds(region); const sizeClim = aug1985to2012.size().getInfo(); console.log(`August 1985-2012 Images: ${sizeClim}`); if (sizeClim === 0) { console.log('No data for August 1985-2012 climatology.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Mean SST for August 2019 const img2019 = aug2019.mean(); const mean2019 = img2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('analysed_sst').getInfo(); // Mean SST for August 1985-2012 climatology const imgClim = aug1985to2012.mean(); const meanClim = imgClim.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('analysed_sst').getInfo(); // Validate results if (mean2019 === null || meanClim === null || isNaN(mean2019) || isNaN(meanClim)) { console.log('Calculation failed: null or NaN values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert from Kelvin to Celsius if necessary (OI SST is in Kelvin) const temp2019_C = mean2019 - 273.15; const tempClim_C = meanClim - 273.15; // Validate temperature ranges if (temp2019_C < -10 || temp2019_C > 40 || tempClim_C < -10 || tempClim_C > 40) { console.log('Invalid temperature range detected.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Aug 2019 Mean SST: ${temp2019_C.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Aug 1985-2012 Mean SST: ${tempClim_C.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Difference: ${(temp2019_C - tempClim_C).toFixed(2)}°C`); // Answer: Is 2019 cooler than climatology? if (temp2019_C < tempClim_C) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
